$comment: Engine-wide release rules for scripts/lib/package-game.mjs; docs/release.md explains every field and check. The web root (<gameDir>/public), the public asset allowlist (release.assets) and the identity come from the active game's game.json. Preflight runs the unit tests before every package; requireSmoke makes deploy:web and wavedash:push refuse a source without a passing npm run smoke (preflight cannot run smoke: smoke packages).

preflight.name: typecheck
preflight.why: a release compiles: engine, game and add-ons
